title: Men’s March Madness Sets Opening-Day Viewership Record

facts.fact: Thursday's TV coverage of the NCAA men's tournament opening day across CBS, TNT, TBS, and truTV averaged a record 9.1 million viewers, up 6% from last year, according to preliminary Nielsen data.
facts.quote: TV coverage across CBS, TNT, TBS, and truTV averaged 9.1 million viewers, up 6% from last year.

facts.fact: Primetime coverage of the Thursday men's March Madness opening day averaged 12.2 million viewers, a first-round record.
facts.quote: Viewership shot up further during primetime, averaging 12.2 million viewers to set a first-round record.

facts.fact: Nielsen now tracks out-of-home audiences in 100% of the contiguous United States, whereas in prior years OOH audiences in at least one-third of the country, particularly rural areas, were not tracked.
facts.quote: it now tracks OOH audiences in 100% of the contiguous United States. In prior years, OOH audiences in at least one-third of the country—particularly rural areas—were not tracked.

facts.fact: Duke's 93–49 Round of 64 win over Mount Saint Mary's featured Cooper Flagg with 14 points and 7 rebounds.
facts.quote: Cooper Flagg, who scored 14 points and grabbed 7 rebounds in the 93–49 win

facts.quote: The CFP officially announced plans to expand in 2027.
